methodology: Static Acorn AST of all route modules mounted in index.js plus 2 explicit server health GETs. v1 is default configurable API_VERSION. Explicit method registrations only; implicit HEAD/OPTIONS and wildcard 404 excluded. References scan tracked/untracked repository source, tests, docs and configuration, excluding private env files/dependencies. Candidate line references require manual semantic interpretation; dynamic calls may not match and no match does not prove external non-use. Role constants expanded in README legend; handler scope/preconditions summarize controller/service review, not exhaustive formal proof. No endpoint removed.
